latestMilestone: PR #16 is merged into the canonical SWIR_OS main at 369a1e55f5b275074d53ce4883625b46fff425aa. Native GTK4 Software Center and Update Center are now wired in the graphical System Edition image to the authenticated package-transaction broker. Mutations require an exact broker preview bound to a plan digest, explicit user confirmation, peer-derived Polkit authorization and the existing journaled package transaction path; native GTK surfaces still do not invoke apt, sudo or pkexec directly. Software Center exposes the verified brokered install path, while Update Center exposes verified per-package brokered updates and intentionally keeps bulk update mutation disabled. The exact final PR head passed all eight triggered workflows, including graphical session, Live USB install and full graphical installer UEFI E2E. Roadmap remains 51/65 (78.5%) because this wiring does not by itself complete the essential daily-use native app suite or release readiness. Physical Live USB qualification remains pending; Secure Boot and legacy BIOS are not claimed.
